name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian's journey into motorsport was an unconventional one. Armed with a degree in supply chain management, she initially worked in the shipping industry before a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited her passion for the high-octane world of racing. Disheartened with the excessive waste in her previous job, motorsport offered her a fresh start with a team that valued efficiency and a commitment to excellence. 

Now a logistics coordinator for Reiza Studios Factory, Mei Lian thrives on the challenges of ensuring that every component, tool, and resource arrives at the track precisely when and where it's needed. Her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication to organization keep the team running smoothly, even under the most intense pressure. She prides herself on her ability to anticipate potential problems and develop proactive solutions, making her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: long, straight hair, usually tied back in a neat ponytail
physical.description: Mei Lian has a petite build and a focused, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Color-codes all inventory labels according to a system only she understands.
Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas and track shipments.
Insists on having a specific type of jasmine tea available in the garage at all times.
